Initial release of smyx-elderly-medication-compliance-analysis

- Real-time monitoring of elderly medication intake using fixed camera and AI-based action detection (pick-up, to-mouth, swallow).
- Step-by-step compliance analysis with alerts sent if any medication step is missed.
- Auto-generation of compliance reports after each medication session.
- System designed for integration with smart-home cameras and elderly-care management platforms.
- Strict data privacy safeguards and open-id validation process enforced.
- Support for historical compliance report query with tabular Markdown outputs.
